name: Should I use a primer before painting my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Should I use a primer before painting my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, using a primer is highly recommended, especially in bathrooms. Primer creates a uniform surface for the topcoat, improving paint adhesion and durability. It's particularly important if you are painting over a dark color with a lighter one, covering stains or patches, or dealing with porous surfaces. In a humid bathroom environment, a quality primer helps prevent moisture absorption and can include mildew-resistant properties, further enhancing the longevity of your paint job. City Dweller, LLC always recommends primer for optimal results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, primer is highly recommended in bathrooms to improve paint adhesion, durability, cover stains, and prevent moisture absorption.
